description: Land Acquisition - Mahakoowana, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It involves taking possession of a specific land parcel described in detail (including location, boundaries, and extent), which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the land acquisition order and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a Hybrid type.
